title: Sleeping With 100 People on an Aircraft Carrier
asof: Figures from US Navy reports 2006–2025 · full video on the channel

shots.s: Imagine sharing your bedroom with a hundred people.
On an aircraft carrier, that's normal.
Sailors sleep in berthings, with racks stacked three high.
So close that rolling over could wake the guy above you.
Day or night, jets slam down on the deck above.
The catapults fire, and the bang rings through the steel.
And someone is always getting up for their shift.
